question: Unsaon pag-apply ug partial retirement sa usa ka linya sa negosyo ug unsa ang mga kinahanglan i-pass?
answer:
Sa pag-apply sa partial retirement sa isa ka linya sa negosyo, ang mga kinahanglan nga dokumento nimo sa Business Bureau sa Davao City ang:

1. Affidavit of Partial Retirement (notarized) stating the reason, effective date of retirement and line of business to retire - [S3]
2. Secretary Certificate / Board or Partnership Resolution (notarized) stating the retirement of the business - [S3]
3. Submit pertinent documents and application form for Partial Retirement sa District Treasurer’s Office - [S1]
4. Proceed to the City Treasurer’s Office for payment - [S2]
5. Submit Application for Partial Retirement, official receipts if applicable and pertinent documents sa Business Bureau office - [S3]

Wala nako nakit-an nga kinahanglan nga dokumento kabuhi sa City Treasurer’s Office kung wala pa kang outstanding unpaid taxes and charges. (Wala akoy nakit-an nga impormasyon bahin sa Citizens' Charter tungod sa pag-require sa outstanding unpaid taxes and charges.)

ground_truth: Partial retirement requires a notarized Affidavit of Partial Retirement stating the reason, effective date, and business line to retire (or Board/Partnership Resolution), SPA if represented, representative ID, and latest business permit. Approval and tax reassessment by the City Treasurer are required.
